newsitem.title: ITALY: U.S. director wins EU-sponsored drama prize.
newsitem.headline: U.S. director wins EU-sponsored drama prize.

text.p: U.S. theatre director Robert Wilson won the 60,000 Ecu ($48,600) Europe Prize for Theatre on Sunday for stimulating interest in drama and his versatility in a variety of genres.
The respected annual award, set up in 1986 by an arts association in Taormina, Sicily, and sponsored by the European Commission, is awarded to individuals or drama institutions.
Wilson, 55, of Waco, Texas, was nominated in 1986 for the Pulitzer Prize for drama for "Civil Wars", an international co-production which he helped create.
Past winners of the Europe Prize include Giorgio Strehler of Italy and Heine Mueller of Germany.
